flagged.evidence: The proof writes the complement as “(r_q(r_p x r_p)) y r_q z” and calls it a product of m-2 reflections. With w = x r_p y r_q z, that displayed expression counts ℓ(x)+ℓ(y)+ℓ(z)+2 = m reflections, so it does not establish the needed m-2 bound. Regrouping as (r_q r_p x r_p r_q)(r_q y r_q)z gives the required m-2 factorization; this is an immediately repairable proof gap.
